p: Victoria Road runs up through Govanhill and ends at the gates of Queen's Park, one of the south side's best green spaces, with a cracking view over the city from the flagpole at the top.

Govanhill is one of the most diverse corners of Glasgow, and the food reflects it: you'll find everything from Pakistani grills to Eastern European bakeries along the main streets. The historic Govanhill Baths are nearby, and Hampden Park, Scotland's national stadium, is a short trip away at Mount Florida, so the area gets busy on big match days. Admiral is an adult gaming centre, strictly 18+, so it's not for the kids.
